about: What the report looks for in an app held to ASVS level 1 that would make it level 2 (gap analysis of 7 October 2026, finding 17; ADR-024, Later, 9 October 2026). Read by crates/sv-check/src/level_hints.rs. A match is a question for the owner, never a finding: a name in the code is a hint, not proof of what the app holds. Routes are matched as a quoted path; names are matched as whole identifiers, case and underscores aside (bloodPressure, blood_pressure, and BLOOD-PRESSURE are one name).
